gen-zen-dots-gf-tuffy: Friendly, techy lettering from Zen Dots, each shape given plenty of space. Tuffy, a sans-serif, writes like a pencil that never presses harder, so paragraphs of text glide past with its widely parted s.
gen-zen-dots-gf-varela-round: Varela Round reads cleanly, its strokes free of hairlines and shadows, with wide-mouthed rounds in the lowercase. And Zen Dots up top adds a friendly, techy flourish that the plain-spoken body never tries to match.
gen-zen-dots-gf-wix-madefor-display: Contemporary and gently flared, Wix Madefor Display keeps its curve ends apart. Zen Dots takes the display heading role with a friendly tech streak, while the sans-serif body below quietly lets it lead.
gen-zen-dots-gf-ysabeau-office: Techy but friendly, Zen Dots gives each letter its own breathing space over Ysabeau Office, whose curves end open. And if Zen Dots is made small, its generous openings lose their punch next to the sans body.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Zen Dots is a techy, friendly display face with openings that stay generous at every weight. Zalando Sans Expanded sets text in sparse, widely gapped rows, and its c tips never creep toward touching.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpande: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded turns its curves open-mouthed, modern in feel. Zen Dots handles the display heading with techy, friendly spacing, and paragraphs under it should read smoothly without snagging on a tight shape.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Zen Dots leaves lots of space around its techy, friendly letters. ZCOOL XiaoWei, the body, shows only a quiet contrast between strokes, with no ink pooling where curves turn in, so the text stays modern and clean.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Dots is the techy, friendly display voice here, every letter given plenty of space. But Zen Maru Gothic does the quieter job, its bowls never thinning at the sides so a read never snags.
gen-zen-dots-ibm-plex-sans: Zen Dots gives every letter a wide, friendly berth, with a techy display edge. IBM Plex Sans stays technical yet approachable, with a wide channel into every bowl, and a heading made small would lose its spacious charm.
gen-zen-dots-zilla-slab: Zen Dots keeps its display letters spaced out and friendly, with a techy streak. Zilla Slab, a technical slab-serif body with a broad opening on every bowl-ended curve, supplies the sturdiness.
